newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania launches new three-month treasury bills.
newsitem.headline: Romania launches new three-month treasury bills.

text.p: Romania's Finance Ministry said it would launch next Thursday an issue of 300.16 billion lei worth of three-month treasury bills to cover part of the 1996 budget deficit.

The bills, maturing on January 30, 1997, will be offered with a coupon giving an annual yield equal to the three-month Bucharest Interbank Bid Rate (BUBID) set five working days ahead of the public subscription session.
The 91-day papers will be placed by the central bank and can be bought by commercial banks operating in Romania and their corporate clients.
Three-month BUBID was 49.6 percent on Thursday.
The budget deficit was 1.9 trillion lei for January-August and is expected to stand at 4.27 trillion lei at end-1996. -- Mirela Eremia, Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
